mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Profile (user_id, preferred_name, pronouns, email, introduction, avatar, school_name, graduation_year, major, interest, profile) VALUES (#{userId}, #{preferredName}, #{pronouns}, #{email}, #{introduction}, #{avatar}, #{schoolName}, #{graduationYear}, #{major}, #{interest}, #{profile})
mapper.update: UPDATE Profile SET preferred_name = #{preferredName}, pronouns = #{pronouns}, introduction = #{introduction}, avatar = #{avatar}, school_name = #{schoolName}, graduation_year = #{graduationYear}, major = #{major}, interest = #{interest}, profile = #{profile}, email = #{email} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.name FROM Profile p, Course c, Learn l WHERE p.user_id = l.user_id AND l.course_id = c.id AND l.course_status = "completed";
mapper.update: UPDATE Profile SET privacy = #{privacy} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT privacy FROM Profile WHERE user_id = #{userId}
